description: This Kotlin source file defines the DashboardFragment class, which is part of an Android application's UI. The fragment displays AI-powered recommendations and quick action buttons, dynamically rendering suggested files for quick sharing based on AI categorization.

classes.name: DashboardFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment displaying AI recommendations and quick actions, including suggested files for quick sharing based on AI categorization.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of DashboardFragment.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Initializes the view hierarchy of the fragment, creates the main container, and populates it with headers, info texts, and quick actions.

methods.name: renderHeader
methods.description: Renders a header text view inside the container.

methods.name: renderInfo
methods.description: Renders an informational text view inside the container.

methods.name: renderQuickActions
methods.description: Creates and adds quick action buttons for sharing and cloud connection.

methods.name: makePill
methods.description: Creates a MaterialCardView styled as a pill for quick action buttons.

methods.name: runAi
methods.description: Runs the AI categorizer asynchronously to fetch suggested files and display them.
